Tarot de Marseille.
Drawn for Kamala.

Seventy-eight original card faces inspired by the Marseille tradition. Open any card for a closer look.

The 22 major arcana and 16 court cards have individual woodcut-inspired illustrations. The 40 numbered minor cards use ornamental suit compositions with exact pip counts. Justice remains VIII and Strength XI.
